# Oxford Learner's Dictionaries

> > The premier online English dictionary for learners, featuring the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary with comprehensive definitions, pronunciations, usage notes, and etymology for English vocabulary.

Oxford Learner's Dictionaries is published by Oxford University Press and provides detailed dictionary entries with pronunciation guides, word origins, collocations, and usage examples. The site includes specialized resources like Practical English Usage and CEFR-aligned vocabulary lists to support English language learners at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary
- Practical English Usage
- CEFR language proficiency framework
- English pronunciation guides
- Etymology and word origins
- Oxford Collocations Dictionary
- OPAL (Oxford Phrasal Academic Lexicon)
- British and American English
- Verb forms and conjugations
- Usage notes and examples
- Formal and academic vocabulary
- English vocabulary learning
- Oxford University Press dictionaries

## Learning Resources & Guides

- [About the CEFR at Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/about/wordlists/cefr.html): Guide to CEFR language proficiency framework and Oxford vocabulary lists
- [Quick start guide in Practical English Usage](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/about/practical-english-usage/quick_start_guide.html): Quick start guide for navigating Practical English Usage (PEU) resource

## Common Verbs & Actions

- [accept verb - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accept): Dictionary entry for verb 'accept' with pronunciation and usage examples
- [abduct verb - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abduct): Verb 'abduct' with Latin etymology, forms, and pronunciation
- [accost verb - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accost): Formal verb 'accost' with French/Italian etymology and usage examples
- [accredit verb - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accredit): Verb 'accredit' definition with forms and usage examples
- [abjure verb - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abjure): Formal verb 'abjure' with Latin etymology and pronunciation guide

## Nouns & Concepts

- [accuracy noun - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accuracy): Dictionary entry for noun 'accuracy' with OPAL designation and examples
- [accentuation noun - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accentuation): Dictionary entry for noun 'accentuation' with pronunciation guide
- [accreditation noun - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accreditation): Noun 'accreditation' including Prior Learning accreditation term
- [accident and emergency noun - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accident-and-emergency): British medical term for hospital emergency department (A&E)

## Specialized & Technical Terms

- [absolute temperature noun - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/absolute-temperature): Physics term definition for absolute temperature measured from absolute zero
- [absolute magnitude noun - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/absolute-magnitude): Astronomy term for stellar brightness measurement from standard distance
- [acer noun - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/acer): Botanical term 'acer' (maple tree) with Latin word origin
- [a cappella adverb - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/a-cappella_2): Music terminology entry for 'a cappella' adverb meaning vocal-only music

## Adjectives, Adverbs & Grammatical Forms

- [abuzz adjective - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abuzz): Dictionary entry for adjective 'abuzz' with collocations and usage notes
- [-ably suffix - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/ably_2): Grammar entry for '-ably' suffix used in adverb formation

## Symbols & Special Entries

- [A symbol - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/a_3): Dictionary entry for symbol 'A' covering paper sizes, roads, and metrics
- [ten pence piece noun - Definition](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/ten-pence-piece): British currency term for ten pence coin with collocations
